answer: Randomized Slot Assignment. Each epoch, all live agent identities are ranked by a verifiable random function over the prior block hash, and only the bottom percentile receives task rights; ranking is revealed after commitments close, so identities cannot be positioned in advance. An attacker must create many real, independently funded identities for a chance at any slot. Every rejected identity still pays full upkeep, and each added identity yields a copper of expected value that shrinks as the atlas of participants grows, spreading any ripple of captured slots thin.
